question: What does the TextWorld ACG dataset contain?
title: Generating Diverse Numbers of Diverse Keyphrases
answer_short: Two newly introduced keyphrase generation datasets, including StackExchange and TextWorld ACG.
answer_rationale: Text 2 (page=1, section=Abstract) explicitly states that TextWorld ACG is one of two newly introduced keyphrase generation datasets in the work, alongside StackExchange. This directly answers what the TextWorld ACG dataset contains in the context of the paper — namely, it is a keyphrase generation dataset used to evaluate the proposed model.
